## Sydney Rental Repair Email Draft

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

A professional, polite, and firm message you can send to your landlord. It asks for repair within 7 days, written confirmation, and keeps the tone calm and clear.

## Email Draft and Pre-Send Checklist

### Subject
**Urgent repair request: leaking kitchen sink and mold in 2-bedroom unit**

### Email
Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are well.

I am writing to follow up on an issue in my 2-bedroom apartment in Sydney. The kitchen sink has been leaking, and I have also noticed mold growth under the cabinet. This issue started on **2026-01-08**.

I sent a text message about this once already, but I have not yet received a response. As the leak and mold may worsen if left unresolved, I would appreciate it if the repairs could be arranged within **7 days** of this email.

Please also provide **written confirmation** of when the repair will be attended to and who will be handling it.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[Your Phone Number]

### Before You Send
- Take clear photos of the leaking sink and mold under the cabinet.
- Save a screenshot of the text message you already sent.
- Note the date and time you first noticed the issue: **2026-01-08**.
- Keep copies of all emails, texts, and replies.
- If possible, note whether the leak is active, getting worse, or affecting storage/cabinets.
- Include your full address and preferred contact details in the email.
